# `Atmosphere` — engine binding surface

- **`Atmosphere`** — retail table VA `0x00B9A578`, 37 required cfuncs.

**GENERATED — do not edit by hand.** Regenerate with `cargo run -p mercs2_script --bin emmylua-gen`.

For IDE autocomplete on the same surface, load the paired EmmyLua stub — see `output/emmylua/mercs2/Atmosphere.lua` (regenerated by the same command).
